LESSON 01 · BEGINNER

Meet your first notes

Three notes are all you need to start making music.

A LITTLE REMINDER

Take your time.

Sit or stand tall, relax your shoulders, and bring the flute to your lips. Aim a gentle stream of air across the embouchure hole, like blowing across a bottle.

It’s completely normal if your first sound is airy. Experiment with the angle of your air and celebrate the small wins.

Practice tip ✦

Try each note for four slow counts. Rest, breathe, and try again.

READING MUSIC

Five lines, lots of possibility.

The five lines are called the staff. Notes can sit on a line or in a space. As notes move higher on the staff, their pitch gets higher too.
